newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan overnight rate slips below 4.5 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan overnight rate slips below 4.5 pct at close.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Thursday, deepening a persistent recent downtrend, but dealers said they expected the rates to stabilise on Friday.
The overnight interbank rate finished at a strikingly low 4.491 percent against Wednesday's 4.607 finish, with 30-day commercial paper down to 4.60-4.65 percent from 4.70-4.75.
The central bank issued T$5 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit on Thursday afternoon to mop up excess liquidity, but dealers said the amount was too small.
Dealers said next week's payments of T$30 billion in government bonds were likely to prevent the money rates from declining further.
The bond market remained dull as players stepped to the sidelines ahead of Friday's 10-year bond auction.
